Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
def two_sum_indices(values, target):
    seen = {}
    for i, value in enumerate(values):
        complement = target - value
        if complement in seen: return seen[complement], i
        seen[value] = i
    return None

assert two_sum_indices([2, 7, 11, 15], 9) == (0, 1)
```
explanation: Store prior values by index and look up each complement. Expected O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space; the returned indices are distinct.
